'''Amathera Aelfdene Casmir Lounault''' is a former [[Tarabon]]er noblewoman who was raised to the position of [[Panarch]] of Tarabon. 

== Appearance ==
She has many of the physical characteristics that are common to Taraboner females. She wears her long, dark hair in multiple braids and has large dark eyes. She has a pouty, rosebud mouth with a petulant look to it. She has not yet reached middle age and is quite beautiful.

==Activities==
=== Made Panarch ===
Amathera was invested as Panarch despite being rejected by the [[Assembly of Lords]], and primarily attained her position by being the lover of King [[Andric]]. During the recent civil war in Tarabon, the Panarch's Palace was surrounded by [[Whitecloaks]] and occupied by [[Liandrin]] and her group. Amathera was held prisoner by the [[Black Ajah|Black]] sisters and tormented.{{ref/book|4|52}} She is then rescued by Elayne and [[Egeanin Tamarath]], knocking out [[Temaile Kinderode]] who had been tormenting her, in the process.{{ref/book|4|54}}

Although Amathera seemed to have no clue as to what the lives of the common people were like when she is raised as Panarch, [[Elayne]] thought that she had a true concern for justice.{{ref/book|4|55}}  However, at least before being taken captive by the [[Seanchan]], Amathera knew what her position was and knew what she could do and the respect that her position entailed. During that time, this often made her seem quite selfish. 

=== Made ''da'covale'' ===
When the [[Seanchan]] arrived in Tarabon, Amathera was captured, but refused to submit to them. As a result, she was made ''[[da'covale]]'' by the High Lady [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]]. She was renamed '''Thera''' and trained as a [[shea dancer]].

Thera was brought to [[Amadicia]] and later [[Ebou Dar]], where [[Juilin Sandar]] fell in love with her. When [[Mat Cauthon]] and his group escaped, Juilin took Thera with him, and she eventually becomes his lover.

She along with the rest of the group, join and travel in [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]] as a cover to escape Ebou Dar.

She is still scared of [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] and still prostrates herself and the ground in front of them whenever they are near.

=== Learning some backbone ===
When Egeanin is demoted from the Blood, she tries to teach Amathera to stand up for herself and tries to befriend her.

After a skirmish with Darkfriends in [[Maderin]] Mat and the rest of his group decide to leave Luca's show. While riding through [[Altara]] they meet up with the [[Band of the Red Hand]] and begin to travel with them.

When the Aes Sedai traveling with Mat finally leave, Juilin and Thera travel with them, making for [[Tar Valon]]. It is assumed that she remains in the Tower during the fighting of the [[Last Battle]], since she is not mentioned, but Juilin is.
